description:
Yazılım, Web tasarımı, Oyunlar benim ana ilgi alanım.

Ekibimize katılırsan, seni saygılı ve adaletli bir ortamda bekliyor olacağız.
summary: We have designed a web-based game in which you build a rocket, travel to various planets, collect data, and send it back to Earth. Using the NASA DONKI API, the game incorporates real-time space weather data from the planet you are currently visiting, and you can land on Earth or other planets.
details: The game works by using physics engine made by Javascript and HTML+Css. The impact of the project is that people from poor countries can experience space missions and play a fun game of space
